_about: Final BotFails configuration, chosen on the development episodes only (improvement/dev_split.json): per-task camera, regions, questions and decision rule. Left/right are as seen in the image.
_selection: A check is used only if it falsely fails at most 1 of 12 random normal training frames per phase (prompt checks v1-v3, see botfails_benchmark/README.md and evaluation/FIDeL/README.md). No VLM hold question: the gripper signal already says that an object is held, and every hold wording failed on 1-12 of 12 normal frames from this far camera. Tasks without an accepted check (buttons: top of the box not visible; screws: screws too small) have checks [] and fallback 'dino'.
